story.fullStory:
Tim Scott's "Swear" — original release 1985. "Swear" is a 1980s pop song by Tim Scott McConnell, released by Sire Records in 1983.

Artist: Tim Scott · Title: Swear · Album: Swear · Year: 1983 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1980's/Tim Scott - Swear.mp4.

It was covered by Sheena Easton for her 1984 album A Private Heaven and released as its third single in the US, reaching number 80 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1985.

Background
The music video to promote the song was a campy/tongue-in-cheek music video of a hippy-based pagan/black mass set in a church.
